status: postprocessing and synthetic controls only; no solver rerun or verdict change
target: OpenFOAM Foundation 13 frozen high-gradient MMS archives

derivative_diagnostic.operator: periodic centered second-order finite difference (three-point roll stencil)
derivative_diagnostic.reference_counterpart: evaluate exact manufactured velocity on the identical archived cell centers, then apply the identical discrete derivative operator
reported_separately: analytic-reference sampled peak discrepancy (total diagnostic, includes reconstruction error)
reference-only stencil floor against analytic derivatives
computed-versus-stencil-matched-reference discrete gradient and vorticity differences
continuous-field or inter-sample error certificate (must remain false absent a validated bound)

synthetic_controls.acceptance: exact-sample control has zero computed-versus-matched-reference difference and nonzero stencil floor; injected control recovers the analytic discrete difference to floating-point tolerance

rationale: This artifact validates diagnostic decomposition only. Any future quality thresholds require a separate preregistration before new solver runs.
